mapper.select: SELECT id, email_draft_id, gmail_connection_id, request_key, message_id_header, email_send_attempts_status, gmail_message_id, created_at, updated_at, gmail_thread_id, attempt_count, error_message, sent_at FROM email_send_attempts WHERE email_draft_id = #{draftId}
mapper.update: UPDATE email_send_attempts AS attempt SET email_send_attempts_status = 'SENDING', attempt_count = attempt.attempt_count + 1, error_message = NULL, updated_at = now() FROM email_drafts AS draft WHERE attempt.id = #{attemptId} AND attempt.attempt_count = #{attemptCount} AND attempt.email_send_attempts_status = 'FAILED' AND draft.id = attempt.email_draft_id AND draft.email_drafts_status = 'FINALIZED'

UPDATE email_send_attempts SET email_send_attempts_status = 'UNKNOWN', error_message = #{errorMessage}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND attempt_count = #{attemptCount} AND email_send_attempts_status IN ('SENDING')

UPDATE email_send_attempts SET email_send_attempts_status = 'FAILED', error_message = #{errorMessage}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND attempt_count = #{attemptCount} AND email_send_attempts_status IN ('SENDING', 'UNKNOWN')

UPDATE email_send_attempts SET email_send_attempts_status = 'SENT', gmail_message_id = #{gmailMessageId}, gmail_thread_id = #{gmailThreadId}, sent_at = #{sentAt}, error_message = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND attempt_count = #{attemptCount} AND email_send_attempts_status IN ('SENDING', 'UNKNOWN')
